skill_name: Write a story about a person's struggle to overcome their fear
workflow: Martin was a young man who had always been a bit timid and shy, but it was his intense fear of spiders which really held him back. He would avoid going into places, stay home from work and school, and wake up at night to obsess over the possibility of a spider nearby. He knew he had to find a way to overcome his fear, so he decided to put himself through a rigorous program of exposure therapy.
